title: Black Bean Satay
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on the classic Southeast Asian dish, featuring grilled black bean satay served with a sweet and tangy sauce.
instructions: Soak the satay skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Drain and pat dry the skewers with paper towels.
Thread 3-4 black beans onto each skewer.
Brush the skewers with peanut oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the satay for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the black beans are tender and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, whisk together honey and 2 tbsp of water in a small bowl.
Brush the honey glaze onto the grilled satay and serve immediately.
Optional: Serve with additional honey glaze for dipping.
